lines.h1: Tiimo or Structured? Here's the answer in ten seconds.
lines.h2: If you want one clean timeline of your day, Structured.
lines.h3: If you want a planner built for neurodivergent brains, with more support around the plan, Tiimo.
lines.h4: Now, five rounds to prove it. Plus one bonus round, where a third app comes in.
lines.r1b: Structured puts your whole day on one line. Every task is a block sized to how long it really takes.
lines.r1c: Tiimo splits the day into morning, day and evening, with soft icons instead of a wall of text.
lines.r1d: For pure time blindness, one line is the most direct. Round to Structured.
lines.r2b: Tiimo is designed for neurodivergent people first, from the onboarding to the look.
lines.r2c: Structured is a general planner that a lot of ADHD people just happen to love.
lines.r2d: Round to Tiimo. Though fewer choices on screen can help an ADHD brain too.
lines.r3b: Tiimo's Co-planner turns a brain dump into timed tasks, and can split a big task into steps.
lines.r3c: Structured's AI schedules what you type. On the newest iPhones, it can split a task into subtasks too.
lines.r3d: Tiimo does more of it, on more devices. Round to Tiimo.
lines.r4a: Round four. Staying with the task.
lines.r4b: Structured has a Pomodoro timer, and widgets that tell you what's next.
lines.r4c: Tiimo's visual countdown sits with you while you work, right on your lock screen.
lines.r4d: Round to Tiimo, by a hair.
lines.r5b: Structured has an opt-in Energy Monitor. You rate how draining each task is, and it warns you when the day is too much.
lines.r5c: Tiimo doesn't advertise anything like it. Round to Structured.
lines.sc: Three rounds to two for Tiimo. But don't pick the better app. Pick the one built for your problem.
lines.b1: One more round. The moment you freeze on a task you've been avoiding.
lines.b2: Both apps can split a task into steps now. But both start from planning your day, not from the one task you're stuck on.
lines.f1: Full disclosure, that's the problem we built FOCO for. It starts from the task you're putting off.
lines.f2: It breaks the stuck task into tiny steps, a few minutes each.
lines.f3: Then it's one timer and one task, with a companion working next to you.
lines.o1: So. Structured for one clean line. Tiimo for a planner built around your brain.
lines.o2: And FOCO for when the plan is fine, but you can't start. Tell me in the comments which one you are.
